subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 15th day of Planting in the year 579.
source_quote: Planting 15, 579

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: Moathouse elevation
fact: The Moathouse was once the outpost of the Temple of Elemental Evil, its watchtower an advance base for raids, looting, and destruction.
source_quote: The mouthouse was once the outpost of the Temple of Elemental Evil, its watchtower an advance base for raids, looting, and destruction.

subject: battle of emiry meadows
fact: The events ended with the Battle of Emiry Meadows.
source_quote: This ended with the Battle of Emiry Meadows.

subject: Burne's Folly height
fact: The tower is 55 feet tall, a smaller tower rising inside the greater at about 35 feet above the ground.
source_quote: This structure is some 55 feet tall, a smaller tower rising inside the greater at about 35 feet above the ground.

subject: Burne's Folly landing height
fact: The stone landing is about 10 feet above the ground.
source_quote: which terminate in a landing about 10 feet above the ground.

subject: Burne's Folly base splay
fact: The base has a splay to about 6 feet in height.
source_quote: a splay around the base to about 6 feet in height.

subject: tower armory count
fact: The tower contains 12 shields, four long swords, two broad swords, four spears, two battle axes, and the heads and homes of various creatures.
source_quote: 12 shields, four long swords, two broad swords, four spears, two battle axes, and the heads and homes of various creatures.

subject: grovewell caretaker
fact: The grove’s caretaker has neatly pruned the trees, and the grass is well-tended.
source_quote: The caretaker has neatly pruned the trees, and the grass is well-tended.

subject: grove stone alignment
fact: A carefully placed line of bluish stones sets off the path to a rock cairn where flowers, nuts, berries, and leaf garlands are placed.
source_quote: A carefully placed line of bluish stones sets off the path to a rock cairn where flowers, nuts, berries, and leaf garlands are placed.

subject: jaroo's observation mission
fact: Jaroo was sent here to observe the events after the defeat of the Temple of Elemental Evil.
source_quote: Jaroo was sent here to observe the events after the defeat of the Temple of Elemental Evil.

subject: jaroo's warning about moathouse
fact: The circles of outposts that you and your friends have uncovered are too early, similar to the plots of the original temple, to be a coincidence.
source_quote: The circles of outposts that you and your friends have uncovered are too early, similar to the plots of the original temple, to be a coincidence.

subject: jaroo's collection box
fact: The robed man points to a collection box.
source_quote: pointing to a collection box.

subject: temple of st. cuthbert size
fact: The Temple of St. Cuthbert is a massive, imposing structure that is ridiculously too large for such a small village with so few souls.
source_quote: a massive, imposing structure that is ridiculously too large for such a small village with so few souls.

subject: terjon's information demand
fact: Whatever information you get must be shared with me and me alone. The safety of the good people of Oerth may hang in the balance.
source_quote: Whatever information you get must be shared with me and me alone. The safety of the good people of Oerth may hang in the balance.

subject: rufus's deputy demand
fact: As my deputies, you are required to talk to me first. If you refuse my offer of being a deputy, I will have you arrested, or worse, if you explore the Moathouse.
source_quote: As my deputies, you are required to talk to me first. If you refuse my offer of being a deputy, I will have you arrested, or worse, if you explore the Moathouse.

subject: burne and rufus relationship
fact: Burne and Rufus are an item — Burne is a mage with scuffed robes, Rufus is a military commander in a revealing blouse.
source_quote: Sequoia immediately understands that they are an item.

subject: burne's folly entrance
fact: The outer door of the tower lowers to form a bridge to the stone landing.
source_quote: The outer door of the tower lowers to form a bridge to the stone landing.

subject: burne's folly architecture
fact: The lower and upper battlements are machicolated, and the merlons are pierced for archers.
source_quote: The lower and upper battlements are machicolated, and the merlons are pierced for archers.

subject: jaroo's distrust of burne and rufus
fact: Jaroo distrusts the intentions of Burne and Rufus, and Terjon's goals.
source_quote: Jaroo distrusts the intentions of Burne and Rufus, and Terjon's goals.

subject: sequoia's information withholding
fact: Once he has information, he will decide what to share.
source_quote: Once he has information, he will decide what to share.

subject: grove path termination
fact: A small path leads beyond the shrine to a low-roofed wooden building placed under the great boughs of the central oaks of the thicket.
source_quote: A small path leads beyond the shrine to a low-roofed wooden building placed under the great boughs of the central oaks of the thicket.

subject: temple of elemental evil influence radius
fact: The temple enslaved the conquered folk, and then they were forced to construct yet another fortress further west, spreading the evil power of the Temple in ever-growing rings to encompass all of the lands around its base.
source_quote: The temple enslaved the conquered folk, and then they were forced to construct yet another fortress further west, spreading the evil power of the Temple in ever-growing rings to encompass all of the lands around its base.

subject: rufus's information control
fact: Rufus wants the heroes to volunteer to share information only with him.
source_quote: Rufus wants him to volunteer to share information only with him, but Sequoia isn't sure.

subject: grovewell stone alignment
fact: A carefully placed line of bluish stones sets off the path to a rock cairn where flowers, nuts, berries, and leaf garlands are placed.
source_quote: A carefully placed line of bluish stones sets off the path to a rock cairn where flowers, nuts, berries, and leaf garlands are placed.

subject: jaroo's grove location
fact: The grove is a place of worship. The caretaker has neatly pruned the trees, and the grass is well-tended.
source_quote: The grove is a place of worship. The caretaker has neatly pruned the trees, and the grass is well-tended.

subject: burne's folly tower structure
fact: The tower is 55 feet tall, a smaller tower rising inside the greater at about 35 feet above the ground.
source_quote: This structure is some 55 feet tall, a smaller tower rising inside the greater at about 35 feet above the ground.

subject: jaroo's conclusion about outposts
fact: The circles of outposts that you and your friends have uncovered are too early, similar to the plots of the original temple, to be a coincidence.
source_quote: The circles of outposts that you and your friends have uncovered are too early, similar to the plots of the original temple, to be a coincidence.

subject: rufus's threat of arrest
fact: If you refuse my offer of being a deputy, I will have you arrested, or worse, if you explore the Moathouse.
source_quote: If you refuse my offer of being a deputy, I will have you arrested, or worse, if you explore the Moathouse.

subject: burne's folly interior architecture
fact: Shuttered arrow slits flank the door to the room, and two murder holes are in the ceiling.
source_quote: Shuttered arrow slits flank the door to the room, and two murder holes are in the ceiling.

subject: burne's folly cooking area
fact: Flanking the inner portal are two fireplaces, where most of the cooking is done by two to three servants.
source_quote: Flanking the inner portal are two fireplaces, where most of the cooking is done by two to three servants.

subject: burne's folly seating capacity
fact: Trestle tables can be extended down and across to accommodate 40 people during a feast or revel.
source_quote: Trestle tables can be extended down and across to accommodate 40 people during a feast or revel.

subject: burne's folly wall decorations
fact: The walls themselves are hung with tapestries and decorated with shields, arms, and hunting trophies—12 shields, four long swords, two broad swords, four spears, two battle axes, and the heads and homes of various creatures.
source_quote: The walls themselves are hung with tapestries and decorated with shields, arms, and hunting trophies—12 shields, four long swords, two broad swords, four spears, two battle axes, and the heads and homes of various creatures.

subject: burne's folly ramp system
fact: Ramps curving upwards and downwards lead to other levels.
source_quote: Ramps curving upwards and downwards lead to other levels.

subject: burne's folly entrance mechanism
fact: The outer door of the tower lowers to form a bridge to the stone landing.
source_quote: The outer door of the tower lowers to form a bridge to the stone landing.

subject: burne's folly stairway
fact: Its entrance is accessible only by going up a curving flight of stone stairs, which terminate in a landing about 10 feet above the ground.
source_quote: Its entrance is accessible only by going up a curving flight of stone stairs, which terminate in a landing about 10 feet above the ground.

subject: burne's folly arrow slits
fact: There are several arrow slits around the tower.
source_quote: There are several arrow slits around the tower.

subject: burne's folly guard station
fact: Two men-at-arms watch from its roof.
source_quote: Two men-at-arms watch from its roof.

subject: jaroo's grove path
fact: A small path leads beyond the shrine to a low-roofed wooden building placed under the great boughs of the central oaks of the thicket.
source_quote: A small path leads beyond the shrine to a low-roofed wooden building placed under the great boughs of the central oaks of the thicket.

subject: jaroo's message to sequoia
fact: You must go and investigate the Moathouse. And when you have found what you are looking for, you must tell me and me alone. Do not tell anyone else because the agents of the Temple may even be here.
source_quote: You must go and investigate the Moathouse. And when you have found what you are looking for, you must tell me and me alone. Do not tell anyone else because the agents of the Temple may even be here.

subject: burne's reaction to temple resurgence
fact: Burne is horrified, 'That's impossible.'
source_quote: Burne is horrified, 'That's impossible.'

subject: rufus's information protocol
fact: It would be essential that we present it to our boss in Verbobonc.
source_quote: It would be essential that we present it to our boss in Verbobonc.

subject: temple of st. cuthbert interior
fact: Inside, he finds Calmer, who excitedly introduces him to Terjon.
source_quote: Inside, he finds Calmer, who excitedly introduces him to Terjon.
